text:
elen: Noticing a cluster of embedding 413s where preflight said OK. payloads ~550KB, preflight_estimate ~480KB, runtime_actual ~620KB. routing chose large model but runtime rejected.
marco: any common headers? X-Embed-Meta / X-Client-Meta noise?
elen: yes, both variants in the wild. ingress normalization might be flaky.
neha: I suspect estimator drift. our preflight heuristic (dims*4) ignores JSON overhead. we should surface estimator_version and preflight_estimate in telemetry.
tyler: propose a cheap "shadow" estimator at runtime for sampled requests: runtime_shadow_estimate, preflight_estimate, drift_pct. emit preflight_hash to join traces. sample 1% initially.
marco: good idea. also add metric embed_estimator_drift_rate and a dashboard tile showing top client_hashes by drift. truncate hashes to 8 chars in UI.
neha: also: error payload for 413 should include code embed_oversize_estimate_diff, estimate_bytes, runtime_bytes, request_id so SDKs can surface guidance.
elen: product/SDK note: don't auto-split by default. opt-in header X-Embed-Client-Behavior=allow_split if user wants partial responses.
tyler: will add a feature-flag estimator_shadow and telemetry counters. infra-bot: deploy 1715100030 by tyler: enable estimator_shadow -> staging
infra-bot: deploy 1715100030 by tyler: success -> staging
marco: console UX: add columns estimated_size / actual_size and a small drift sparkline on route page. internal feature-flag to show full hashes to SRE only.
neha: also add alert: drift_rate > 0.1% AND >200 requests in 1h. conservative to avoid noise.
tyler: scheduling prod-canary for 2h with sample_rate=5% and tag canary=estimator-shadow. will keep traces 14d for canary.
elen: thanks — I'll monitor and post any spikes.
infra-bot: deploy 1715100060 by tyler: estimator-shadow -> prod-canary (5%)
tyler: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/12567 adds shadow estimator, preflight metadata, drift telemetry, and 413 error upgrade.
marco: followups: tyler (PR + deploy), neha (telemetry + dashboard), elen (monitoring + traces).
